Pasewalk ( German: [ˈpaːzəvalk] ⓘ , Polish : Pozdawilk code: pol promoted to code: pl [ 2 ] ) is a town in the Vorpommern-Greifswald district, in the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern in north-eastern Germany . Located on the Uecker river, it is the capital of the former Uecker-Randow district, and the seat of the Uecker-Randow-Tal Amt , of which it is not part.
